newsitem.title: GREECE: Worker dies in explosion at Greek ammunition plant.
newsitem.headline: Worker dies in explosion at Greek ammunition plant.

text.p: One worker was killed and at least five were injured, one of them seriously, by an explosion at an ammunitions plant in the town of Lavrion, 65 km (40 miles) southeast of Athens on Friday.
Lavrion mayor Stavros Papastavropoulos, who witnessed the accident, told a local radio station the explosion was caused by a leak of flammable potassium nitrate gas during waste disposal.
A 52-year-old worker was killed instantly while another was seriously injured, he said.
Papastavropoulos said the accident was "the most tragic event that could have occurred in this town".
Local police and owners of the Powder and Cartridge Company had no immediate comment on the incident.
